reopening the certified connected-kernel or operator-leaf scopes without a current hash-bound causal contradiction or SACG-approved contract change

immutable deterministic input provenance with fingerprint 03a4254b001550f052b3671fbbee5666027a8d6f7e91e693bb1dcb1fb6ff6012

executable_actions.on_failure: Remain needs_repair and fail closed; keep the active Stage7 retry and contamination barriers, mark all failed or dependency-skipped outputs as non-promotable, and do not run backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream generation, runtime ABI release, or board runtime. If the complete tensor catalog, real target-model reference, immutable numeric/testbench contract, all-weight consumption proof, exact wrapper identity, or Vivado authority binding is missing, classify the result as a verification-capability failure rather than hardware correctness. If a fresh exact-board trace is available but shows only input or prefetch progress, treat it as localization evidence and not a pass. Do not rerun or repair the connected kernel unless a new current trace contains direct core start, ingress, egress, a named causal boundary, and current certificate evidence that explicitly contradicts a certified invariant; otherwise keep the lower-layer certificates closed. Do not modify adapter behavior while source_semantic_repair_eligible remains false.
produces: repaired generated/memory/dut_weight_binding_manifest.json with per-layer binding and consumption evidence
current exact-board simulation identity and Vivado compile-plan authority binding report
current exact-board AXI/DDR interface report if its dependency is satisfied
fresh hash-bound verification/debug_closure/boundary_trace.json from the exact wrapper and sources, or an explicit blocked diagnostic
CCTG causal repair context identifying the earliest current-layer boundary if the fresh replay fails
repair execution audit stating that checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, testbench, wrapper, and lower-layer certificates were not modified
executable_actions.rationale: The earliest current-layer failure is incomplete multilayer real-weight binding, while the exact-board AXI/DDR checker also lacks authority-bound simulation identity and Vivado command facts. Repair only the generated loader/harness and its evidence bindings. Materialize a complete target-checkpoint tensor catalog, bind every Transformer-block tensor in every target layer, preserve the independent target-model reference and immutable numeric policy, bind the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and the cited source hashes, then rerun case_multilayer_pipeline. If that prerequisite passes, run the exact-board AXI/DDR authority check and a fresh VCS boundary-targeted replay with CCTG analysis. This action must not edit accelerator behavior, substitute a wrapper, alter golden outputs, or repeat the certified connected-kernel replay.

observations: The decisive executed current-layer failure is real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline: DUT binding does not cover every Transformer-block weight in every target layer. This is a verification semantic-loader/binding gap, not evidence that an RTL operator or connected kernel is incorrect.

case_axi_ddr_interface was dependency-skipped and its produced report identifies a separate exact-board harness defect: the simulation identity, compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and simulator executable authorization do not bind the current exact Vivado export facts. Therefore no board AXI, DDR, output, lifecycle, ordering, numeric, or complete-weight-consumption pass exists.

The operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer certificates are live hash-validated evidence. The connected-kernel certificate records complete 1792-beat ingress and egress, terminal last, 416 accepted trace records, preserved first/last-token boundary order, and required elastic cross-token overlap. No current hash-bound trace explicitly contradicts those named invariants.

The prior board observation of input activity before start and zero output is not an authorized RTL root-cause diagnosis: the runner marked source_semantic_repair_eligible=false, the diagnostic applicability is historical_only, and no current lower-layer challenge is asserted. Do not edit the adapter, output module, or connected kernel from that symptom.
The conditional specialist review returned no_split. It adds no executable evidence and cannot substitute for the failed deterministic weight-binding or exact-board authority checkers.

sacg_memory_truth has six open retry requests for this board scope and active contamination barriers for rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts. There is no open scoped backtrack request; do not infer one from omitted global history.

Before any functional acceptance, preserve the immutable checkpoint, deterministic input provenance, independent target-model inference for the same checkpoint and input, current numeric comparison policy or frozen framework loose defaults, generated semantic testbench hashes, and proof that every in-scope Transformer-block tensor was consumed by the bound DUT loader.

The accelerator scope remains Transformer blocks only. Do not add embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, sampling, or other model-tail tensors to DUT implementation or weight-coverage goldens.
proposed_actions: Execute one bounded current-layer exact-board semantic-loader and AXI/DDR authority repair: prove complete in-scope Transformer-block tensor binding, repair the current board simulation identity/compile-plan authority references without changing the exact wrapper or source set, rerun the failed current-layer gate, and only then request a fresh exact-board boundary trace/targeted replay. Keep all lower-layer replay and promotion blocked.
risks: Treating the aggregate functional_sim failure as a proven RTL failure would bypass causal localization; the current functional result is dependency and harness contaminated.
Repairing only a manifest while leaving the exact-board identity or Vivado compile authority unbound would produce another non-executable simulation result.
Using files present on disk as proof of weight use, or deriving expected outputs from random data or RTL output, would violate the semantic verification contract.
A board trace showing ingress, DDR, or prefetch progress without direct output/lifecycle-frontier evidence cannot establish liveness or reopen the connected kernel.
Changing tolerance, checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, testbench contract, memory layout, or wrapper sources during repair would invalidate the comparison and board contracts.

Any fresh direct start/ingress/egress trace that names a causal boundary and explicitly contradicts a certified lower-layer invariant would require a SACG-recorded targeted challenge; absent that evidence, lower layers remain closed.
output.summary: Keep board_axi_ddr_closure fail-closed. The earliest actionable failure is a current-layer verification/integration capability gap: incomplete full-scope Transformer-block weight binding, compounded by an exact-board simulation identity and Vivado-command authority mismatch. Execute one bounded exact-board semantic-loader and AXI/DDR harness repair, then obtain a fresh current-layer boundary trace/targeted replay. Do not reopen or rerun the certified connected-kernel replay.
